POONAM MULEY

Senior Business Analyst — Program Manager — Financial Services & Investment Domain

poonammuley352@gmail.com

+91- 8240839870

Bengaluru,

Karnataka

Professional Summary

Experienced Senior Business Analyst with 4.5+ years in financial services progressing from fund operations to investment operations at Goldman Sachs (Asset & Wealth Management Private). Specialise in requirements management, product delivery and Agile/Scrum execution. Hands-on with Alteryx automation, AI-assisted analytics, and stakeholder reporting. Deep domain knowledge across private credit, loans, trade lifecycle, fund accounting, and KYC/AML compliance. Experienced supporting deal teams and advisory functions across Growth PE, Sustainability, and Real Estate.

Core Competencies

Business & Product Analysis Requirements Elicitation, BRD/FRD, Process Mapping, GAP Analysis, Use Cases, UAT testing, Acceptance Criteria

AI & Automation AI-Assisted Analytics, DocAI, LLM Workflow Automation, RPA Automation, Prompt Engineering, Advanced excel, Alteryx, Python, SQL

Program & Project Management Program Governance, SLA Design, Delivery Coor- dination, Change Management, Risk Controls, Audit Support,

Data & Reporting KPI/KRI Dashboards, P&L Analysis, Performance Analytics, Power BI, Tableau, Data Reconciliation

Agile & Scrum Sprint Planning, Backlog Management, User Story Writing, Scrum Ceremonies, JIRA, Agile Delivery

Domain Knowledge Private Credit, Derivatives, Fixed income, Bonds, Loans, Trade Lifecycle, Fund Accounting, KYC/AML, Growth PE, Sustainability, Real Estate

Work Experience

Senior Business Analyst

7/2026- Present

Synechron- Bengaluru

Senior Business Analyst, Asset & Wealth Management (Private)

11/2024 – 04/2026

Goldman Sachs – Bengaluru

Elicited and documented business requirements from investment and operations stakeholders; translated findings into KPI-aligned executive dashboards, enabling data-driven portfolio decisions.

• Mapped end-to-end back-office workflows for private credit and loans (deal initiation → settlement

reconciliation → position validation); identified process gaps and drove operational improvements.

Built an Alteryx workflow automating payment tracking with scheduled reconciliation alerts — eliminating ˜5 hours of manual effort weekly and improving break detection accuracy.

Facilitated Agile/Scrum ceremonies (sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives) across process improve-ment and system enhancement initiatives, maintaining delivery cadence for cross-functional teams.

Applied AI-assisted analytics and LLM-based summarisation to accelerate requirements documentation and surface data anomalies, cutting manual MI review time by ˜30%.

Managed advisor and consultant engagements across Growth Private Equity, Sustainability, and Real Estate verticals — scoping deliverables, tracking performance metrics, and consolidating outputs for investment committee reviews.

Leveraged advanced Excel and SQL to conduct advisory fee benchmarking and cost optimisation analysis; synthesised findings into a senior leadership presentation that drove strategic pricing decisions.

Supported onboarding of Life Sciences portfolio companies (biotech/pharma) within the private credit mandate, coordinating KYC/AML documentation with compliance and deal teams.

Business Analysis – Process Specialist I

09/2024 – 11/2024

FactSet Research Systems Inc – Hyderabad

Gathered requirements and redesigned project management dashboards during a system transition, improving reporting visibility across financial data workflows for key stakeholders.

Authored standardised reporting frameworks for Q3 financial data processes, ensuring accurate and timely data availability during the migration period.

Business Analysis – Assistant Manager, Fund Operations

10/2021 – 08/2024

KFIN Technologies Limited – Hyderabad

Led the I-match reconciliation transformation, replaced manual reporting with automated cash, position, and trade reconciliation, significantly improving data accuracy for mutual fund clients.

Defined requirements and delivered the Penny Drop KYC automation, reducing investor onboarding verification time by 25% and improving compliance accuracy.

Directed UAT planning and execution for the K-prism platform launch, defining UAT strategy, documenting over 200 test cases, and tracking defects to achieve a 98% pass rate for critical functionalities prior to go-live sign- off by stakeholders.

Managed product backlogs in JIRA, authored user stories with acceptance criteria, and coordinated sprint deliverables with dev teams — ensuring on-time feature releases.

Documented corporate actions workflows (dividend bookings, entitlement validation, break resolution) and designed SOPs for trade settlement and compliance processes.

Automated mid-year and year-end audit support using Python for reconciliation documentation and data integrity validation across fund accounting and trading records, reducing manual processing time and minimising reconciliation errors.

Projects

CloseMate — Month-End Close Tracker: Portfolio Link

Finance ops tracker built and shipped independently. CloseMate is a self-contained, browser-based month-end close tracker — no login, no setup, no backend. Built in HTML/JS in under 5 hours. It has four modules: a live close dashboard, a categorised task checklist with owner and status tracking, a reconciliation tracker with variance flags, and an issues log with escalation paths useful for Project/Program Managers.

Education

PGPM – Marketing & Operations

IBS Mumbai (ICFAI Business School), Mumbai

BE – Mechanical Engineering Savitribai Phule Pune University, Pune

Certifications

Alteryx Designer Core Certified — Alteryx

04/2022

04/2019

sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
Work Experience
Senior Business Analyst
7/2026- Present
Synechron- Bengaluru
Senior Business Analyst, Asset & Wealth Management (Private)
11/2024 – 04/2026
Goldman Sachs – Bengaluru
Elicited and documented business requirements from investment and operations stakeholders; translated findings into KPI-aligned executive dashboards, enabling data-driven portfolio decisions.
• Mapped end-to-end back-office workflows for private credit and loans (deal initiation → settlement
reconciliation → position validation); identified process gaps and drove operational improvements.
Built an Alteryx workflow automating payment tracking with scheduled reconciliation alerts — eliminating ˜5 hours of manual effort weekly and improving break detection accuracy.
Facilitated Agile/Scrum ceremonies (sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives) across process improve-ment and system enhancement initiatives, maintaining delivery cadence for cross-functional teams.
Applied AI-assisted analytics and LLM-based summarisation to accelerate requirements documentation and surface data anomalies, cutting manual MI review time by ˜30%.
Managed advisor and consultant engagements across Growth Private Equity, Sustainability, and Real Estate verticals — scoping deliverables, tracking performance metrics, and consolidating outputs for investment committee reviews.
Leveraged advanced Excel and SQL to conduct advisory fee benchmarking and cost optimisation analysis; synthesised findings into a senior leadership presentation that drove strategic pricing decisions.
Supported onboarding of Life Sciences portfolio companies (biotech/pharma) within the private credit mandate, coordinating KYC/AML documentation with compliance and deal teams.
Business Analysis – Process Specialist I
09/2024 – 11/2024
FactSet Research Systems Inc – Hyderabad
Gathered requirements and redesigned project management dashboards during a system transition, improving reporting visibility across financial data workflows for key stakeholders.
Authored standardised reporting frameworks for Q3 financial data processes, ensuring accurate and timely data availability during the migration period.
Business Analysis – Assistant Manager, Fund Operations
10/2021 – 08/2024
KFIN Technologies Limited – Hyderabad
Led the I-match reconciliation transformation, replaced manual reporting with automated cash, position, and trade reconciliation, significantly improving data accuracy for mutual fund clients.
Defined requirements and delivered the Penny Drop KYC automation, reducing investor onboarding verification time by 25% and improving compliance accuracy.
Directed UAT planning and execution for the K-prism platform launch, defining UAT strategy, documenting over 200 test cases, and tracking defects to achieve a 98% pass rate for critical functionalities prior to go-live sign- off by stakeholders.
Managed product backlogs in JIRA, authored user stories with acceptance criteria, and coordinated sprint deliverables with dev teams — ensuring on-time feature releases.
Documented corporate actions workflows (dividend bookings, entitlement validation, break resolution) and designed SOPs for trade settlement and compliance processes.
Automated mid-year and year-end audit support using Python for reconciliation documentation and data integrity validation across fund accounting and trading records, reducing manual processing time and minimising reconciliation errors.

It has four modules: a live close dashboard, a categorised task checklist with owner and status tracking, a reconciliation tracker with variance flags, and an issues log with escalation paths useful for Project/Program Managers.
